name: Kakeru Run
description: Kakeru Run is a quiet, grid-based WordPress theme built for running shoe fitting shops and specialist footwear stores. Designed around ruled editorial columns, high-key photography, and WooCommerce integration, it highlights footwear lasts, video gait sessions, and technical specifications. The layout pairs clean typography with responsive spec tables to present running footwear with calm precision.

summary.en: A running shoe fitting shop: a hexagon-outline stage in a ruled grid, 1:1 specimen tiles on coloured paper, 2+1 info rows with a big clay pill and one brown order band.

store.withoutPlugin: The Shoes page shows the six pairs as static specimen cells (photograph, pair label, name, lasts, drop, weight, price) with a note to order by email or in the shop; store templates are not used.
